title: [CQ-M06] Rollout integration and hardening
description:
Objective: Own complete multi-package/platform regression, matched pilot assessment, documentation sweep and promotion decision.

Deliverable: Rollout integration and hardening. This is task M06 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Verification command (fresh, exit0 required): cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test

Dependency aliases (wired by Moe task ids after import): M05.
definitionOfDone: All six workstreams compose without stale-revision/check/recipe/isolation bypasses.
Report 50% planner and 30% retrieval targets plus accepted-change cost/time/quality; do not claim unmeasured savings.
Record promotion or non-promotion and unsupported hardware honestly; skipped real-VM tests do not certify support.
Fresh verification `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` exits0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

implementationPlan.description:
Docs sweep, part 2: docs/MCP_SERVER.md. Check every claim against the landed code, with path:line in the step note.
- `### moe.get_activity_log` (~line 2805): the PROJECT_SETTINGS_UPDATED event and its exact payload.
  - Always: setting, from, to, transition, outcome.
  - Refused activation adds codeName and unsupportedCapabilities.
  - Rollback adds retainedStrictTasks/Ids, retainedStrictAttempts/Ids and unreadableSnapshots.
  - Ids are capped at 10, sorted. The record is a best-effort audit: rotation keeps 5 generations, and a hand edit is not recorded.
- `### moe.complete_task` (~line 516), strict completion: EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY also refuses a running attempt whose own snapshot is verified-local after a project rollback, so attempt-level strictness is never downgraded. Live-only strictness (an attempt captured as legacy) still rolls back.
- `### moe.get_context` Execution policy context (~line 300): effectiveProfile is task-level; attemptSnapshot shows the open attempt's own strictness.
- The WS UPDATE_SETTINGS / SETTINGS_UPDATED section, if one exists: a refused activation still answers ERROR with the canonical message, and transitions are recorded.
Run the same doc guard tests as step 2 again.

Decision consistency. Re-check the promotion decision against the final state; do not re-decide it.

Confirm that:
- assertExecutionProfileReady still refuses verified-local;
- the platform and hardware statements in docs/baselines/cq-m06/README.md (CQ-M06a's file) match what R13 and I06 landed and what this box offers. Probe with `command -v multipass`, `java -version` and the WSL/Windows facts noted in step 1;
- the composition fixtures and workstream suites the README cites exist at the cited paths.

If a statement has drifted, edit only that line of the README. Report it in complete_step.modifiedFiles: it is M06a's file, so it is not in this plan's affectedFiles. Keep src/benchmarks/rolloutDecision.test.ts unchanged and green; run it with `npx vitest run src/benchmarks/rolloutDecision.test.ts`.

Never record promotion: the readiness authority still refuses and no matched pilot exists. A pilot needs a separate, explicitly approved batch task, never this one. If step 5 later contradicts a platform statement, fix the line and re-run step 5 in full, so that the gate is fresh after the last edit.

VERIFY ONCE, fresh, after all edits. This is the last gate of the whole CQ rollout, so run every package and label each result by platform.

Linux-native snapshot (mem gotcha-daemon-linux-snapshot-gate):
- `git archive HEAD` of the WHOLE repo;
- overlay ONLY this task's four docs, plus the decision README if step 4 edited it;
- run `npm ci` per package under `env -i` with a Linux-only PATH and NO_COLOR=1, so no MOE_* variable is set, after checking each lockfile matches its tree modulo CR;
- cmp the overlaid files against the snapshot.
Run:
- `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test`. THIS is the complete_task verification: supply its command, exit code and output tail. Also run `npx tsc --noEmit`.
- `cd packages/moe-proxy && npm test` (snapshot only: its pretest rebuilds dist, so never run it in the shared tree).
- `cd packages/moe-claude-plugin && npm run build && npm test`.
- `node --test scripts/tests/*.test.mjs`. Record every real-VM or local-runner case that skipped, and why.
- `npm run lint` at the root, `bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh` and `bash scripts/tests/postflight.sh`.
- `cd moe-vscode && npm ci && npm test && npm run compile`.

Windows host. WSL has no JDK (mems gotcha-jetbrains-gradle-gate-from-powershell, gotcha-qa-windows-launcher-tests-from-wsl, convention-jetbrains-gradle-lease):
- `cmd.exe /d /c "set GRADLE_OPTS=-Xmx512m&& cd /d D:\projexts\moes\moe-jetbrains && .\gradlew.bat test --rerun"`, then count the TEST-*.xml results newer than the start time;
- the launcher node --test suites natively on Windows (PowerShell 5.1, pwsh 7 and Git Bash engines) from a scratch copy of scripts/.

Anything that cannot run here (no Multipass, no macOS, no real VM) is recorded as NOT RUN, never as passed or certified.

Compare counts with each package's pre-change HEAD baseline. A newly failing test is a regression. Error handling: never patch production code in this docs-and-gate task and never weaken an assertion. Instead, file a bug task naming the owning task, and use moe.report_blocked with blockedOnTaskIds when it breaks a DoD item.

Put a per-package results table in the step note: command, platform, pass/skip/fail and exit code.

ADVERSARIAL REVIEW of the WHOLE CQ-M epic diff and its composition with the other five workstreams. Do it once, as the last step; load adversarial-self-review.

Gather the completion shas of every CQ-M row from epicSiblings landing: M01a-f, M01, M02, M03a-e, M03, M04, M04b, M04c, M05, M06a and M06b. Run `git show --stat` per sha, then read targeted hunks; do not dump the full diff.

Check:
1. Producer/consumer drift:
   - M01's snapshot floor against M05's rollback retention and complete_task's attempt-level readiness;
   - M02's usage correlation against M04's report fields and M06a's quoted figures;
   - M05's record payload against the docs written in steps 2-3.
2. Any path that enables verified-local, or claims isolation, readiness, trust or verified completion: an env var, a persisted label, a client hello, a caller field, the observe record or a snapshot.
3. Delivery policies ranked with max(), or a change to legacy/observe live-policy behavior.
4. Any savings or support claim in the docs without matched evidence; any skipped test cited as certification.
5. Every docs claim from steps 2-3 traced to code (path:line).
6. Error handling: refusals stay fail-closed and write nothing.
7. .moe hand edits, Git writes, or peers' bytes reverted.

Record each finding and its disposition in the step note. A real defect becomes a new task, or a report_blocked when it breaks a DoD item, never a silent fix.

reopenReason: Unblocked on the human's explicit, repeated instruction ("unblock tasks", then "unblock", 2026-10-27). Plan now instead of parking. Use prerequisites' landed code or approved plans where they exist. Otherwise use their task description, DoD and docs/plans/2026-10-24-ai-code-quality-and-context.md. If a prerequisite's contract must be designed first, split it out (SPIDR, as with R10a) instead of report_blocked. Re-block only if any possible plan would breach a rail. For this row that means the no-activation-before-certification rail.
priorBlockedReason: Cannot submit a complete non-speculative six-workstream integration plan: M05 is BLOCKED with no implementationPlan, and its contract/isolation/client hardening prerequisites F12/R13/I06 are BACKLOG with no plans or frozen integration APIs (fresh contexts checked). Current delivery/executionProfile.ts assertExecutionProfileReady deliberately rejects verified-local unconditionally; baseline report/corpus and provider configuration do not constitute matched-pilot outcomes or isolation certification. Naming future rollout/evidence/certification entrypoints or replacing final composition with current fail-closed unit checks would invent contracts or omit DoD. Replan after declared prerequisite contracts and baseline outcomes land. No source changes, no activation, no savings/support claim, no plan submitted. This block is on missing contracts, not REPL silence or dirty files.

acceptanceCriteria: docs/CONFIGURATION.md, docs/SCHEMA.md, docs/MCP_SERVER.md and CLAUDE.md match the landed CQ-M05 behavior; each claim is traced to path:line.
CQ-M06a's decision record and guard test, and CQ-M06b's composition fixtures, pass unchanged in the final run.
The full regression table covers daemon, proxy, claude-plugin, scripts, lint, parity, postflight, VS Code and JetBrains, and the Windows launcher engines. Anything not runnable is marked NOT RUN.
Fresh `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` exits 0 and is the complete_task evidence.
invariants: verified-local stays refused, and nothing in the docs or the decision implies readiness, isolation or achieved savings.
No production code, test weakening, .moe edit or Git write in this task.
docs/plans/2026-10-24-ai-code-quality-and-context.md is not edited (a benchmark test reads it).
